raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Fixes #48019. A LoRA trained on the text-only `*ForCausalLM` of a multimodal model silently does nothing when served on the multimodal wrapper. This resolves such adapters on the model side, in `LoRAModelManager._get_lora_layer_weights`, so it works for every multimodal wrapper without per-model mapper rules.

This builds on #49525 by @fooSynaptic (co-author), which fixes the same bug through a `WeightsMapper` fallback and only covers wrappers whose mapper has a `model.language_model.` rule. This PR covers those wrappers too, plus the ones without such a rule.

## Claims

- Text-named adapters (`model.layers.*` / `lm_head`) now apply to the language model of multimodal wrappers, including wrappers with no `model.language_model.` mapper rule or a different LM prefix (`llm.`, `model.text_model.`), e.g. Llama4, DeepSeek-V4, MiniCPM-V, Idefics3/SmolVLM.
- Adapters that already match (trained on the full multimodal class), tower/connector LoRA, and text-only models are unchanged.

## Validation

```bash
pytest tests/lora/test_lora_manager.py tests/lora/test_utils.py tests/lora/test_lora_checkpoints.py
```

- New test `test_text_only_lora_binds_to_multimodal_language_model`: 3 passed (all 3 fail on main).
- The three files above: 58 passed.

E2E on 1x H20: one synthetic r=16 LoRA on the LM's q/k/v/o/gate/up/down_proj, saved twice: text-named (`base_model.model.model.layers.*`) and wrapper-named (`base_model.model.model.language_model.layers.*`, or `model.text_model.layers.*` for SmolVLM). Prompt logprobs of 4 prompts from vLLM base / text-named / wrapper-named, compared with an HF reference that has the LoRA merged into the weights.

Mean |Δ logprob| of the text-named adapter vs vLLM base (HF LoRA effect in parentheses):

| model | main | #49525 | this PR | this PR vs HF LoRA (wrapper-named vs HF) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Qwen3.5-4B-Base (0.056) | 0.0000 | 0.0534 | 0.0535 | 0.0146 (0.0134) |
| llava-1.5-7b-hf (0.060) | 0.0000 | 0.0575 | 0.0565 | 0.0126 (0.0111) |
| SmolVLM-256M-Instruct (0.104) | 0.0000 | **0.0000** | 0.0948 | 0.0486 (0.0507) |

vLLM-vs-HF base noise: 0.017 / 0.017 / 0.063. Llama4 and DeepSeek-V4 were not run (too large); they use the same `language_model.` prefix path as Qwen3.5.

## Details

**Root cause.** PEFT on the text-only class (what `AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen3.5-*")` returns in transformers 5.x, i.e. the default TRL SFT path) names modules `model.layers.*` / `lm_head`. vLLM's multimodal wrappers mount the language model under `language_model.`, `llm.` or `model.text_model.`. `activate_adapter` looks weights up by the full module name, finds none, and serves the base model; load-time validation only checks the leaf name (`q_proj`), so nothing fails.

**Fix.** When a LoRA module has no exact match and lives under `get_mm_mapping().language_model`, look it up by its text-only name: the remainder after the prefix, or the remainder under `model.` when the prefix holds a bare decoder. All lookups, including packed (`qkv_proj`, `gate_up_proj`) and MoE packing, go through this function; text-named entries consumed by packing are dropped like the other sub-module entries.

- Exact names always win, so adapters trained on the full multimodal class are unaffected. No tower/connector prefix of any in-tree LoRA-capable multimodal model is nested under its LM prefix, so tower/connector lookups are unchanged.
- The lookup is driven by the model's real modules, so there is no double-mapping risk (e.g. `model.language_model. -> model.` mappers) and no effect on layers owned by other PP ranks.
- No change to base-weight loading or to any model's `hf_to_vllm_mapper`.
- No new validation or error path, and no separate name-matching logic: the fallback lives inside the existing lookup, so any future "adapter matches nothing" check can reuse `_get_lora_layer_weights` and stay consistent with what is actually applied.

---

 from vllm.lora.request import LoRARequest
 from vllm.lora.worker_manager import LRUCacheWorkerLoRAManager, WorkerLoRAManager
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe import GateLinear
+from vllm.model_executor.models.module_mapping import MultiModelKeys
 from vllm.platforms import current_platform
 
 from .utils import create_peft_lora
@@ -138,6 +139,46 @@ def test_from_lora_tensors(qwen3_lora_files, device):
         assert lora.lora_a.shape[0] == 8
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("is_pooling_model", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "lm_prefix,module_name,text_name",
+    [
+        (
+            "language_model",
+            "language_model.model.layers.0.self_attn.o_proj",
+            "model.layers.0.self_attn.o_proj",
+        ),
+        ("language_model", "language_model.lm_head", "lm_head"),
+        (
+            "model.text_model",
+            "model.text_model.layers.0.self_attn.o_proj",
+            "model.layers.0.self_attn.o_proj",
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_text_only_lora_binds_to_multimodal_language_model(
+    lm_prefix, module_name, text_name, is_pooling_model
+):
+    """An adapter trained on the text-only *ForCausalLM must apply to the
+    language model of a multimodal wrapper instead of silently doing nothing."""
+    manager = LoRAModelManager.__new__(LoRAModelManager)
+    manager.is_pooling_model = is_pooling_model
+    manager.supports_mm = True
+    manager.mm_mapping = MultiModelKeys.from_string_field(language_model=lm_prefix)
+
+    def weights(name):
+        return LoRALayerWeights(name, 8, 16, torch.zeros(8, 4), torch.zeros(4, 8))
+
+    text_lora = weights(text_name)
+    adapter = LoRAModel(1, 8, {text_name: text_lora})
+    assert manager._get_lora_layer_weights(adapter, module_name) is text_lora
+    assert manager._get_lora_layer_weights(adapter, "visual.blocks.0.proj") is None
+
+    exact_lora = weights(module_name)
+    adapter = LoRAModel(1, 8, {text_name: text_lora, module_name: exact_lora})
+    assert manager._get_lora_layer_weights(adapter, module_name) is exact_lora
+
+
 def create_lora(
     lora_id: int, model: nn.Module, sub_modules: list[str], device: torch.device
 ) -> LoRAModel:

@@ -891,8 +890,7 @@ def _create_merged_loras_inplace(self, lora_model: LoRAModel) -> None:
             # entries that were loaded but did not contribute to the

         for lora in lora_model.loras.values():
             lora.optimize()
@@ -1128,7 +1126,7 @@ def _convert_3d_to_2d_moe_lora(
         down_proj_lora.lora_b = [w1_b, down_b, w3_b]
         # Drop the redundant base_layer entry to avoid double pin_memory
         # and to keep the activation path looking up only the wrapper key.
-        lora_model.loras.pop(module_name + ".base_layer", None)

     def _slice_moe_lora_ep(
         self,
@@ -1224,15 +1222,57 @@ def _get_lora_layer_weights(
         if self.is_pooling_model and not lora_model.check_lora_name(module_name):
             # If it's a pool model, and the layer name is not found,
             # remove the prefix 'model.' and search again.
-            module_name = module_name.removeprefix("model.")
-            if lora_model.check_lora_name(module_name):
-                org_module_name = module_name
+            stripped_name = module_name.removeprefix("model.")
+            if lora_model.check_lora_name(stripped_name):
+                org_module_name = stripped_name
                 logger.info_once(
                     "For the pool model, successfully loaded the LoRA weights "
                     "after removing the prefix 'model.'."
                 )
+        if not lora_model.check_lora_name(org_module_name):
+            text_name = self._get_text_lora_name(lora_model, module_name)
+            if text_name is not None:
+                org_module_name = text_name
         return lora_model.get_lora(org_module_name)
 
+    def _pop_lora_weights(self, lora_model: LoRAModel, module_names: list[str]) -> None:
+        for module in module_names:
+            lora_model.loras.pop(module, None)
+            if text_name := self._get_text_lora_name(lora_model, module):
+                lora_model.loras.pop(text_name)
+
+    def _get_text_lora_name(
+        self, lora_model: LoRAModel, module_name: str
+    ) -> str | None:
+        for name in self._get_text_lora_names(module_name):
+            if lora_model.check_lora_name(name):
+                logger.info_once(
+                    "Loaded text-only LoRA weights for the language model of a "
+                    "multimodal model."
+                )
+                return name
+        return None
+
+    def _get_text_lora_names(self, module_name: str) -> list[str]:
+        """Names a text-only adapter uses for a language-model module.
+
+        Adapters trained on the text-only `*ForCausalLM` (e.g. PEFT on
+        `Qwen3_5ForCausalLM`) name modules `model.layers.*` / `lm_head`, while
+        multimodal wrappers mount the language model under a prefix such as
+        `language_model.` or `llm.`. If the prefix holds a `*ForCausalLM`, the
+        text name is the remainder; if it holds a bare decoder, it is the
+        remainder under `model.`.
+        """
+        if not getattr(self, "supports_mm", False):
+            return []
+        lm_prefix = self.mm_mapping.language_model[0].rstrip(".") + "."
+        if not module_name.startswith(lm_prefix):
+            return []
+        name = module_name.removeprefix(lm_prefix)
+        if name.startswith(("model.", "lm_head")):
+            return [name]
+        return [f"model.{name}", name]
+
     def _get_module_to_save_weights(
         self, lora_model: LoRAModel, module_name: str
     ) -> LoRAFullModuleWeights | None:
